subject: Request to Grant Reengagement Credits for Dormant Sandbox
messages:
From: Pete Dawson <pete@novametrics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Sandbox access — reengagement credits?

Hi Mina,

We were evaluating Redwood earlier this year and had a small sandbox that expired in September. Our engineers need to run end-to-end validation (latency profiling + embedding cost comparisons) to finalize our vendor recommendation. We can't proceed without fresh credits on the account.

Is there any one-off promotional credit or reengagement grant you can provide to get Novametrics back into a short trial window? Ideally something to cover a focused POC (about 2 weeks of sustained tests) — whatever you typically offer for returning prospects.

Happy to share the recent usage export and a short scope if that helps.

Thanks,

— Pete
Director of Data Products
Novametrics

Attachment: usage_report_novametrics.csv (CSV, 42 KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Pete Dawson <pete@novametrics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox access — reengagement credits?

Pete — thanks for the note and for resurfacing Novametrics. I reviewed the attached usage and this looks like a TTL (time-limited) sandbox that ended while you were preparing demos. We typically support a short reengagement grant for former trials when there's a clear POC.

Ben (AE) — can you weigh in on the recommended amount and whether we should attach a short reengagement proposal? Marissa, can sales ops process a one-off promo if we approve?

Proposed quick path:
- Grant a 30,000-token promo credit valid for 21 days tied to Novametrics account ID (so they can run E2E).
- Share a short checklist of POC tests they should run to validate latency/costs, and an optional 30-minute walkthrough with our infra engineer.

Pete, if that sounds workable I'll get this routed for approval today. If you have specific dates for the POC window share them and we'll try to align.

— Mina
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposal_reengage.pdf (PDF, 18 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Pete Dawson <pete@novametrics.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T13:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox access — reengagement credits?

+1 to Mina's approach. Based on Novametrics' prior usage profile (mostly embedding-heavy, short sequences) 30k tokens should be sufficient for the end-to-end run if they focus tests.

Notes / ask:
- I'm comfortable offering 30k-token promo valid 21 days. If they need more we can evaluate after they share initial results.
- Marissa, can you confirm we have the promotional SKU and a promo code we can attach to their account? Also flagging this as a marketing reengagement: would be great to run a small case study if the POC is successful.

Pete — can you confirm an ideal start date (earliest we can make the promo active)? We typically grant after we confirm account identity (email domain) and link to the HubSpot company record.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Pete Dawson <pete@novametrics.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-21T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox access — reengagement credits?

Hi Pete / team — quick update: sales ops approved a one-off reengagement grant. Details below and I copied billing to ensure the promo attaches cleanly.

Promo details (granted):
- Amount: 30,000 token-equivalent credit (~$350 retail value)
- Validity: 21 days from activation
- Activation window: please tell us a desired start date between 2026-12-22 and 2026-12-31; we will enable on that day.
- How to redeem: we will attach promo code to Novametrics account (email domain: novametrics.com) — no payment required to redeem.

Next steps for Pete: reply with a preferred activation date and confirm the HubSpot company record (I linked earlier: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765). Once you confirm, I'll apply the promo and send a confirmation message with the promo code and the short POC checklist.

If you prefer we can also schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with our infra engineer. Ben, flagging for follow-up if they accept.

Marissa Cole
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
